english.note: Use this as the most natural conversational way to say that something is bad for a particular person, body part, or purpose.

exampleSentences.english: Eating so much spicy food is harmful to your stomach.
exampleSentences.traditional: 食咁多辣嘢對個胃唔好。
exampleSentences.jyutping: sik6 gam3 do1 laat6 je5 deoi3 go3 wai6 m4 hou2

english.note: Use this casual construction when you name what the harmful thing is bad for, such as health or the environment.

exampleSentences.english: Staying up late all the time is detrimental to your health.
exampleSentences.jyutping: seng4 jat6 ngaai4 je6 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2
